name: Sensitivity-Aware Vector Clustering
definition: A compression scheme that reduces storage requirements of 3D Gaussian splatting by clustering SH coefficients and Gaussian shape features (scale and rotation) into compact codebooks using sensitivity-aware vector quantization.
summary: Sensitivity-Aware Vector Clustering compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by weighting vector distances with a sensitivity measure to prioritize preserving parameters that significantly affect image quality.
